All Addl. Central PF Commissioners (Political States)

Sub: Grant of exemption from the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 under
Section 17(2A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 — reg.

Ref: This office circular No. C-III/8(1)2011/GJ/EDLI Exempt/3376 dated 13" May,
2014.

Sir,
Please refer to this office circular letter of even number dated 13” May 2014
wherein all Addl. CPFCs (Political States) were requested to forward the consolidated

information zone-wise/region-wise on the subject cited above in the prescribed format
enclosed with the circular letter under reference.

2. It is hoped that all Addl. CPFCs (Political States) must have issued
instructions/directions under their jurisdiction to complete the job in the prescribed
format so that the same is forwarded to Head Office within the due date i.e. 13.06.2014.
By this time some progress must have been achieved by the field offices.

3. In this regard, all Addl. CPFCs (Political States) are once again requested to
forward the consolidated required information zone-wise/region-wise under their
jurisdiction by name to Shri B.K. Batra, RPFC-II (Pension) in Head Office latest by
13.06.2014, It may be ensured that the above information pertaining to any
ROs/SROs is only furnished through their concerned ACCs (Political Sates). Any
information received from field offices will not be entertained by this office.

4. This may be treated as MOST URGENT.

Yours faithfully,

|

(MP. VARGHESE)
